yard: a lonely salt-boilers' log hut on a low hill among marsh reeds, a wattle fence, thin smoke from the roof, a small vegetable patch
shore: a grey sandy river shore with bleached driftwood and pebbles, low waves, mist over the wide river
reeds: a wall of tall dry reeds higher than a man, a narrow trodden path into them, a still dark pool to one side
saltflat: a vast white salt flat cracked into plates under a heavy sky, low salt mounds, a faint path across it
brine: an old square log frame over a black brine well, a broken well sweep, white salt crust on grey ground
grove: a flooded forest of birches and alders standing in still dark water, mossy trunks, mist between them
dyke: an old moss-covered stone dam with wooden sluice gates holding back dark water, a stream falling through the middle gate into a pool
causeway: a log causeway crossing a dark bog toward a palisade of sharpened stakes half-hidden in mist
road: a wide beaten steppe road with deep ruts running to the horizon, a ring of ox carts camped beside it, a shallow river ford
town: a small salt-trading town behind a wooden palisade by a river, thatched and shingled roofs, smoke from chimneys, a market with a big wooden salt scale
bog: a dark peat bog with black pools and sedge tussocks, stacks of cut peat, old digging pits with rusty water
isle: a small sandy island with willows in the middle of a slate-blue river, a dugout boat pulled up on the sand
willow: old pollarded willows with thick trunks by the water, bundles of cut withies, a weathered wooden post
hearth1: inside a log hut at night: a clay hearth with a low fire, an iron pot of soup on it, two wooden bowls and spoons on a plank bench, warm firelight, the corners in deep shadow
hearth2: a log hut seen from outside on a dark rainy evening, warm firelight in its small window and open door, a wet wattle fence, puddles reflecting the light
quarry: an old sand quarry at the foot of a town on the steppe: yellow sand walls, rough shelters of sacking and branches, thin smoke from many small fires sunk in holes, the town's palisade on the rise behind
workshop: a craftsman's workshop yard on the edge of a southern Ukrainian town in autumn: an open shed with a long workbench, a small stone forge glowing red, a whitewashed thatched cottage, an old pear tree heavy with fruit, a carved wooden key hanging above the wooden gate
kryvets: the market square of a small southern Ukrainian river town on a peaceful autumn day: whitewashed houses, stalls under canvas awnings, ox carts, a wooden church with a small green dome, the river glimpsed behind tall poplars
hutir: a hunter's homestead on a low island in endless river marshes at autumn sunset: a small whitewashed reed-thatched hut, a clay smokehouse with thin smoke, nets on poles, a flat-bottomed boat at a wooden landing, reeds and water all around to the horizon
brid: a river ford and ferry crossing on a calm autumn day: a big flat wooden ferry raft on a rope across a wide river, a long low whitewashed tavern with a reed roof by the water, carts of fur traders, willows and reeds
ashtown: the market square of a small southern Ukrainian river town burned in war, on a grey autumn day: blackened house frames with white clay stoves standing alone, charred market stalls, a wooden church without its dome, thin smoke rising, the river glimpsed behind burnt poplars.
ashisle: a burned hunter's homestead on a low island in endless river marshes at grey dusk: a roofless blackened hut, a collapsed clay smokehouse with a wisp of smoke, rows of charred net poles, a half-burned wooden landing, reeds and water all around to the horizon.
yhouse: a lone whitewashed cottage with a high thatched roof at the end of a village street in late autumn, a wattle fence, a well sweep, a woodshed, yellow ash trees behind, warm light in a small window, smoke from the chimney
ysquare: a small northern village square in late autumn: a tall wooden bell tower with three bells, a smithy with smoke, a long communal log house, a richer house with a tin roof and a tall barn, whitewashed thatched cottages around, wet earth
ymill: a wooden water mill with a big wheel on a small creek in late autumn, a low dam and a mill pond, old willows, a farm cart by a fence, grey sky
yapiary: an old apiary at the edge of a dark pine forest in late autumn: rows of log beehives under bark roofs, a tiny low hut with a smoking chimney, tall dark pines behind
ypines: the edge of a dark old pine forest above an empty village pasture in late autumn, a narrow trail disappearing into the dark between the trunks, yellow grass, a low wattle pen
yhill: a small old village graveyard on a low hill with old ash trees in yellow leaves, carved wooden grave posts and stones, one big old standing stone, far away a river and white chalk bluffs under a pale autumn sky
